CustomField.description: Maximum tool invocations allowed for one run, or for each reply of a conversational agent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum tool calls for one run. For an agent with Wait for Reply, the limit applies to each reply. Use a whole number from 0 to 9,999; 0 prevents tool execution. Several calls in one model response count separately. A step that would exceed the budget pauses the run for operator review.
CustomField.label: Max Tool Calls
